verbatim.description: s is sized from getReserves(), but a pair with an unsynced surplus (tokens sent without sync()) absorbs that surplus into reserves during swap(); addLiquidity then sees a different ratio than the closed form assumed, leaving a non-dust residual on the pooler (sUSDS re-poolable; phUSD recoverable only via rescueERC20). Griefing / doc accuracy. quotePool shares the assumption so minLP/minPhusdOut may spuriously revert.
missingMitigations: No sync() or balanceOf(pair)-reserve accounting before sizing

verbatim.description: Constructor validates pair_'s token set but not pair_ == IUniswapV2Factory(router.factory()).getPair(sUSDS, phUSD). Sizing/quote read _pair while the swap and addLiquidity execute on the router factory's canonical pair; a wrong-factory or fork-DEX pair with the same tokens decouples sizing from execution (mis-sized s, wrong quote, LP minted is a different token than pair() reports). Non-obvious deploy-time footgun (Law 3); floors bound loss; LP rescuable. Deploy-script assertion is the cheap mitigation.
